clinic.heroSubtitle: Achieve a brighter, more balanced, and confident smile with custom porcelain veneers from Tribeca Smiles. Veneers can correct stains, chips, gaps, and minor misalignment while creating a natural-looking appearance. Using advanced Digital Smile Design technology, Dr. Frederick Solomon and his team deliver personalized, long-lasting results that enhance both aesthetics and self-confidence.

differentiators.title: Experienced Cosmetic Dentist

treatmentJourney.title: Cosmetic Consultation & Smile Analysis
treatmentJourney.description: Your journey begins with a thorough consultation and smile analysis to understand your aesthetic goals, evaluate your oral health, and determine the best approach for your custom smile makeover.

treatmentJourney.title: Digital Smile Design & Shade Selection
treatmentJourney.description: Using advanced Digital Smile Design technology, we create a virtual preview of your new smile, allowing you to visualize and fine-tune the aesthetics before any treatment, along with precise shade selection.

treatmentJourney.title: Gentle Preparation & Impressions
treatmentJourney.description: A minimal, gentle preparation of your natural teeth is performed, followed by precise impressions. This ensures your custom porcelain veneers will fit perfectly and blend seamlessly with your natural smile.

treatmentJourney.title: Custom Porcelain Lab Fabrication
treatmentJourney.description: While your custom porcelain veneers are meticulously crafted in a specialized lab, you will wear temporary veneers to protect your prepared teeth and maintain your aesthetic appearance.

treatmentJourney.title: Bonding & Final Reveal
treatmentJourney.description: Once your permanent veneers arrive, they are carefully bonded to your teeth, and we unveil your beautifully transformed, natural-looking smile. We ensure your bite and comfort are perfect.

treatmentJourney.title: Follow-Up & Long-Term Care
treatmentJourney.description: We schedule follow-up adjustments and establish a long-term care plan, including hygiene visits and recommendations for nightguards if needed, to protect your investment and maintain your stunning results for years to come.

faqItems.question: How long do porcelain veneers last?
faqItems.answer: Porcelain veneers are highly durable and, with proper care and maintenance, can last for 10-15 years or even longer. Regular dental check-ups and good oral hygiene are key to extending their lifespan.

faqItems.question: How many visits does veneer treatment take?
faqItems.answer: Typically, the process for porcelain veneers involves a few visits. This includes an initial consultation and design, preparation of your teeth, placement of temporaries, and the final bonding of your custom-fabricated veneers.

faqItems.question: Veneers vs. crowns vs. bonding - what's right for me?
faqItems.answer: The best option depends on your specific needs. Veneers are ideal for aesthetic concerns like discoloration or minor misalignment, while crowns are for more significant damage, and bonding for small chips. We'll discuss the best choice during your consultation.

faqItems.question: Will my teeth be ground down for veneers?
faqItems.answer: A small amount of enamel is typically removed to ensure a perfect fit for porcelain veneers, creating a natural look and feel. This preparation is conservative and designed to preserve your tooth structure as much as possible.

faqItems.question: Do you offer financing for cosmetic dentistry?
faqItems.answer: The website does not explicitly state financing options. We recommend contacting our office directly to discuss payment plans and financial arrangements for your cosmetic dental treatments.

faqItems.question: Can I see what my new smile will look like first?
faqItems.answer: Yes, with Digital Smile Design, you can preview your new smile on screen before any work begins. This allows us to design mockups tailored to your facial features and proportions, ensuring you love your results.

doctor.name: Dr. Frederick E. Solomon
doctor.bio: Dr. Frederick E. Solomon is a leading cosmetic dentist in lower Manhattan with over 20 years of experience, dedicated to blending health, science, compassion, and esthetics. He believes in increasing and embellishing one's quality of life through exceptional dental care. Dr. Solomon specializes in cosmetic and restorative dentistry, including transformative smile makeovers, providing patients with confident, beautiful smiles. He is committed to utilizing modern techniques and a patient-centered approach to deliver outstanding results.
